learning_outcomes.text: Frame physics problems as supervised, unsupervised or regression tasks
Prepare, scale and split physical datasets responsibly
Train and evaluate models with physics-appropriate metrics and baselines
Apply neural networks to regression and classification of physical data
Incorporate physical constraints and symmetries into models
Interpret models and avoid data leakage and spurious correlations

integrative_case: A collaboration trains a classifier to separate signal from background in collider data: prevent data leakage in the split, choose metrics robust to class imbalance, encode a known symmetry, and report calibrated uncertainty rather than a single accuracy number.
